_source: fixtures/missions/{Mp,Conft,Hk,Joke,Ovmp,Slim}: tFUN functions (Cfun) and RPNS actor scripts, decoded by tools/gfx/cfun_disasm.py and tools/gfx/extract_actor_scripts.py and evaluated symbolically with the semantics of src/game/cfun/vm.c (retail cfun_exec 0x00457550); the engine's writers of state word 56 from the retail image (captain_events)

_conventions.op: queue = opcode 0x0c, cfun_voice_play 0x00416f10 (appended to the 8-slot ring, dropped when it is full); interrupt = 0x0d, cfun_voice_stop 0x00416f60 (goes to the front and stops the line in flight; on an idle queue the same as queue). The actor-attached 0x0e/0x0f occur nowhere in these maps (voice_op_counts)
_conventions.slot: the player slot the line is about: side 1 = slot 0 (player actor 12), side 2 = slot 1 (player actor 16, or the Sky Captain in a one-viewport game); every Sky Captain line is slot 1
_conventions.probability: the exact chance a line plays each time the gate and the 'then' conditions hold, from the random draws in the stream; weights = each line's share given that one plays
_conventions.timers: timer T counts down in 1/60 s units (store.timer v = v*5 ticks of the 300 Hz clock; cfun_timers_tick 0x00457510 snaps it to 0 below 5 ticks), so 'timer T < 1' and 'timer T == 0' both mean it has run out. cooldown_s = what the line re-arms its timer to
_conventions.poll_period_s: a tFUN function runs its gate every |time_units| * 5 ticks, the first time at a random phase inside one period (cfun_load 0x00436b10, cfun_tick 0x00436be0); repeat = runs whose gate passed before it retires (-1 forever)
_conventions.comparisons: written in natural order: 'word 45 > 0' is the script's `load.w 45; push 0; lt` (0x23 tests top < under)
_conventions.captain_event_word: state word 56 is one slot: the engine overwrites it with the newest event, and a poller whose gate also needs the chatter timer leaves it pending until that runs out or a newer event replaces it

1.name: captain_pushes_on_player_base
1.raised_by: sky_refresh_destination 0x00420ff0 (store at 0x00421042), only in its mode-1 arm. Reached when the decision pass cact_dispatch_types 0x00421910 changes the mode and the new mode is 1 (0x004223c0 tail: entry mode != mode): the scan scored >= 2 (+1 per own tank within 0x68000 of point_00, +10 for its own Dreadnought within 0x78000 -- point_00 is where player slot 0 stood at the captain's construct), so it heads for the player's base with its units. The other callers (construct, respawn, repair) never leave it at 1
1.script: state word 56 == 1 (one viewport only: word 3 == 1), polled by Mp mission fn 46, Conft mission fn 46, Hk mission fn 48, Joke mission fn 46, Ovmp mission fn 46, Slim mission fn 46; the poller zeroes word 56 when its gate passes. Mp: interrupt [31, 56, 57] with chance 1/4 (25%), every 1.35 s; no cooldown in the gate

2.name: captain_fires_on_player
